physics_standard_repeat.summary: A final ordinary eight-environment repeat completed all 345 actions with all eight HDF5 trajectories finite, matching source actions and initial state/camera metadata. It delivered 7.19 aggregate control steps/s including native RGB transfer to CPU, versus 4.92 for Isaac RTX. All three environment-0 videos decoded completely; sampled videos and first/last-environment native images show normal camera/robot motion. This passing ordinary repeat and the passing extra-checking diagnostic do not explain or repair the original non-finite-state failure. No production physics settings were changed.
